$ /bin/bash -c npx mcpjam cloud link --help && npx mcpjam cloud projects --help && sed -n '1197,1237p' cli-reference.md && rg -n '
toolResultContains|toolCall|assertion|schemaVersion|Create an eval suite' public-api.md | head -40
Usage: mcpjam cloud link [options] [project]
Pin this directory to a Cloud project by writing .mcpjam/project.json. The file
contains no secrets and is committed by default; per-developer setups may
gitignore it.
Arguments:
project Project name or ID to pin
Options:
--here Write .mcpjam/project.json in the current directory instead of the
Git worktree root
--remove Remove the nearest project link (current directory with --here)
-h, --help display help for command
Usage: mcpjam cloud projects [options] [command]
Operate the MCP servers saved in your hosted MCPJam projects
Options:
-h, --help display help for command
Commands:
list [options] List the projects you can access
create [options] Create a hosted MCPJam project
update [options] Update project metadata
delete [options] Delete a project and its project-owned resources
capabilities [options] Show what you may do in a project: your role, which
betas the organization has, your plan's limits, and a
can-block of booleans. Ask this before scripting
anything that authors, launches or publishes.
servers [options] List and manage the servers saved in a project
status [options] Health-check every server in a project (hosted doctor
per server)
help [command] display help for command
## `cloud projects servers` commands
Manage the MCP servers saved in a project and connect new ones. All `projects servers` commands require an `sk_` API key (via `--a
pi-key` or the `MCPJAM_API_KEY` environment variable) or a prior `mcpjam cloud login`.
### Shared platform flags
| Flag | Description |
| `--api-key <key>` | MCPJam `sk_` API key (overrides `MCPJAM_API_KEY`) |
| `--api-url <url>` | MCPJam API base URL (defaults to `https://app.mcpjam.com/api/v1`) |
| `--api-header <header...>` | Extra request header as `"Name: value"`, repeatable — for a deployment behind Cloudflare Access, a
WAF, or a corporate proxy. Also `MCPJAM_API_HEADERS`, one per line. Cannot set `authorization`, `idempotency-key`, or `content-typ
### `cloud projects servers connect`
Start a connection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, and validation happen asynchronously. When the serve
r requires OAuth, the command prints a private authorization link and (by default) opens it in a browser. The command then polls u
ntil the request reaches a terminal status.
| Flag | Required | Description |
| `--url <url>` | Yes | MCP server URL to connect |
| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID |
| `--server <id>` | No | Existing server ID, when the project has several on this URL |
| `--name <name>` | No | Name for the server, if one is created |
| `--reauthorize` | No | Force a fresh authorization |
| `--no-browser` | No | Print the authorization link instead of opening it |
